title: Starwatch
description: data of: starwatch.py STAR [--plan | --measure SESSION | --history] --json. A watched star (Tabby's star) imaged through the patrol and measured against the stars round it: the night's brightness on Gaia's G scale beside its usual level, and whether it is dipping. With --plan, the patrol's plan only; with --history, every night measured. Nothing is reported for you.

name.description: The name mount.py and shoot.py know it by.

baseline.description: The median of the other nights, once there are BASELINE_NIGHTS.

dimmer.description: Magnitudes fainter than the baseline (negative: brighter).
